meta.title: Rantau | Find work without the maze
meta.description: Search direct job and vocational opportunities worldwide, understand the requirements, and track every application.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.title: Your next opportunity can start anywhere.
auth.description: Search direct employer and official program pages, see what to prepare, then apply without another complicated profile.
auth.name: Name

search.title: What kind of work are you looking for?
search.description: Use plain language. Include a role, country, pathway, or anything important to you.
search.placeholder: Welder jobs in Japan with visa support, or nursing Ausbildung in Germany
search.emptyBody: Rantau searches the web, verifies source pages, and keeps the direct application link attached to each result.
search.noResults: No strong direct opportunities were found. Try a broader role or location.

profile.title: Tell Rantau what fits you
profile.description: A lightweight profile helps explain readiness. You stay in control and can search before completing it.
profile.cvHelp: Maximum 5 MB and 20 pages. Rantau extracts text privately to improve matching.

tracker.title: Every application, one calm view
tracker.description: Save an opportunity before applying, then update its status as you move forward.
tracker.empty: No saved applications yet. Your saved opportunities will appear here.
tracker.mailBody: Get the latest 10 saved applications at your account email. Rantau creates your private AgentMail inbox only when you ask.
tracker.mailProfile: Save your profile first, then Rantau can create a private inbox and email your digest.

costs.title: What powers each search
costs.description: Rantau uses Convex components instead of parallel infrastructure. Actual cost depends on searches, pages read, emails, storage, and AI tokens.
costs.convex: Database, auth, realtime, files, functions, and static hosting
costs.firecrawl: Web search and readable source pages
costs.starterBody: 100 users, 4 searches each month, up to 10 pages per search
costs.growthBody: 1,000 users, 8 searches each month, up to 10 pages per search
costs.growthCost: About €72 per month, plus measured AI and email
costs.starterGateway: AI Gateway: hard-capped at $10 per month
costs.starterAgentmail: AgentMail: $0 for 3 inboxes, or $200 for up to 150 inboxes
costs.growthGateway: AI Gateway: resize the current $10 cap from measured token usage
costs.growthConvex: Convex: $0 tier or $25 per developer plus usage
costs.growthAgentmail: AgentMail: custom plan if every user needs a private inbox
costs.note: Public list prices checked on 30 August 2026. Firecrawl is shown in EUR for Germany; other providers are shown in USD. Taxes, exchange rates, overages, and model usage can change. The live provider dashboards remain the source of truth.
